verdict.rationale: Lium's docs state that every pod comes with root and Docker-in-Docker, which covers the root-level control half of the story. Remote access is shown only through `lium exec` and a general claim that agents can "connect" to pods. Nothing in the evidence mentions SSH access or bringing your own SSH public keys. Missing for 10: documented SSH access, bring-your-own SSH key registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
